# MyAgentVerse

> Custom 24/7 AI agents that automate calls, follow-ups, and workflows for small and mid-sized businesses. Based in The Woodlands, TX.

MyAgentVerse designs and builds owned (no monthly lock-in) AI automation systems for businesses doing $1M–$5M in revenue. Engagements typically start with a free 30-minute Process Audit that maps the highest-ROI automation opportunities.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What MyAgentVerse does and who it's for.
- [Services](/services): AI agent, workflow automation, and custom build offerings.
- [About](/about): The team, beliefs, and approach.
- [Process Audit](/process-audit): Free 30-minute audit that produces an Automation Opportunity Map.
- [Get Started](/get-started): Book an audit or send a quick question.
- [Results](/results): Case studies and outcomes.
- [Consultation](/consultation): Paid AI Implementation Roadmap call.
- [Build](/build): Custom build engagements.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team directly.
